note: Real. Chris Godwin (TB) dislocated his left ankle in the last minute of Week 7 (Mon Oct 21 vs BAL); surgery and IR on Wed Oct 23. The head coach said he would probably be out for the year but left a small chance of a playoff return. His ESPN 2024 game log has no game after Week 7 (and no 2024 postseason game), so group A. Times come from each page's own metadata or from the X post id; the X posts' wording is from X's embed service. Doubts: ProFootballTalk's postgame story (04:24Z Oct 22) was edited at 16:29Z, after the first ask, so I took Bowles's postgame words from 4for4's item (11:10Z) instead. Godwin spoke at his foundation's gala on Mon Oct 28; the time is ProFootballTalk's write-up (11:37Z Oct 29), and ESPN's own story shows '03:22 AM' with no zone.

news.words: "He's got an ankle, early indication is that it's dislocated," Bowles told reporters. "It doesn't look good."

news.source: Ian Rapoport, NFL Network, on X
news.words: #Bucs WR Chris Godwin will undergo surgery on his dislocated ankle this week, sources say. He'll see a doctor today to determine the damage & is expected to make a full recovery for 2025 — when he'll be a FA.

news.source: Tom Pelissero, NFL Network, on X
news.words: #Bucs WR Chris Godwin is scheduled to undergo an MRI this morning before having surgery on his dislocated ankle that most likely will end his 2024 season, per sources.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (citing Jenna Laine, ESPN)
news.words: Bowles confirmed that Godwin will undergo surgery on his dislocated left ankle and will "probably be out for the year"... Bowles didn't completely close the door on Godwin playing again in 2024 if the Buccaneers make a deep playoff run.

news.source: Ian Rapoport, NFL Network, on X
news.words: #Bucs WR Chris Godwin is having surgery today to repair his dislocated ankle... No one knows how long TB's season will last, but there is even an outside possibility Godwin returns. Not likely. But slight.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (citing Scott Smith, team site)
news.words: The Buccaneers placed Godwin (ankle) on injured reserve Wednesday... Head coach Todd Bowles confirmed Tuesday that Godwin is expected to miss the remainder of the 2024 campaign due to a left ankle dislocation.

news.source: Chris Godwin, at his foundation's event (via ProFootballTalk, citing Jenna Laine, ESPN)
news.words: Godwin said he's heading into rehab with a goal of making it back to the team in time for postseason action. "I mean, I think that's best-case scenario, right? Like absolute best case."
